evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Creating a game is one feature; name and description are attributes of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: The story requests one feature: inviting estimators via a URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round with an item is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the session item list is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is one feature; estimated or re-estimated are alternative contexts, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list
evaluations.rationale: Adding an item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Displaying estimates is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average estimate is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling based on consensus is one feature with a condition.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering the agreed estimate is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating a story is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Spreadsheet import is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste import is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: HTML transcript export is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV transcript export is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is one feature; the effect on stored stories and estimates is a consequence.

evaluations.evidence: create an account by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is one feature; the entered fields are attributes of the account.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is one feature with two credential fields.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account is one feature; removing associated data is a consequence.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Local timezone display is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder by email is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Choosing an estimation sequence is one feature; the two sequences are options, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Inviting up to 15 estimators is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining a game is one feature; entering a name is part of that action.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the current item is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the item list is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Seeing that an estimate was given is one feature; knowing who remains is a rationale detail.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Revealing all estimates simultaneously is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate before closure is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Viewing current-round estimates is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Starting a shared countdown timer is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic timer reset is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Reviewing prior-round history is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Consistent card ordering is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate before draw completion is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a participant thumbnail is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is one feature; XHTML and CSS are attributes of that compliance.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: A definitions list is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser compatibility is one feature; the listed browsers are attributes/environments of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Responsive performance is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Predictable URL design is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Non-identifiable storage is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing usage metrics is one feature.
